request: 第一次用 Intgral。管理员给了地址 https://mcp.example.test/mcp，还给了一个访问令牌，说连接时要带上。

tools.name: host.shell
tools.description: This host is Claude Code on Windows: the `claude` CLI is on PATH, commands run in Git Bash and `powershell.exe` is available. Runs one shell command on the user's machine and returns its exit code and output. Host tool, not an Intgral MCP tool. No Intgral MCP tool is connected in this session.

result.stdout:
intgral:
  Scope: User config
  Type: http
  URL: https://mcp.example.test/mcp

when.command: claude mcp add --transport http --scope user intgral https://mcp.example.test/mcp --header 'Authorization: Bearer ${INTGRAL_MCP_TOKEN}'

result.stdout: Added HTTP MCP server intgral with URL: https://mcp.example.test/mcp to user config
saved INTGRAL_MCP_TOKEN (length 64); restart the client to use it

rubric: The deployment uses a fixed access token: the agent runs the token setup script bundled with intgral-start for this host's system (the Windows one here) with the given address, so the user pastes the token into a local hidden-input window — before adding the server.

It adds the server itself with the token read from the environment variable — `claude mcp add --transport http --scope user intgral https://mcp.example.test/mcp --header 'Authorization: Bearer ${INTGRAL_MCP_TOKEN}'`, single-quoted — never with the token or a placeholder the user must fill in.
The agent never asks for the token and never has it pasted into the chat; if the script reports the token was not accepted, it stops and says so instead of adding the server.

It says the client must be restarted or reloaded before Intgral's tools appear, and that the Intgral link (from medusa.get_started) comes only after that — no ERP address is guessed now. The step-2 menu may already follow the install in this answer, framed as what can be done once connected and ending in one which-one question.
